findings.title: Step-up alternation is not connected end to end to the training runtime
findings.userConsequence: Enabling the flag would not make the live camera session own alternation state, adapt lead-leg evidence, or emit alternation-aware SetResults.
findings.recommendedNextTask: Training step-up alternation runtime integration patch

findings.title: Live step-up grader does not produce lead-leg and floor-boundary evidence
findings.sourceEvidence: src/exercises/setGraders.ts exposes generic repCredited/repCount; src/training/stepUpAlternation/evidence.ts requires observedLeadSide and floor/top flags.
findings.userConsequence: The live camera path cannot prove the FD-005 accepted-rep contract from real pose frames.
findings.recommendedNextTask: Training step-up alternation runtime integration patch

findings.title: Backend compact training-state sync omits step-up alternation generated metadata
findings.userConsequence: A remote compact snapshot would not preserve the generated alternation plan metadata needed by an integrated runtime path.
findings.recommendedNextTask: Training step-up alternation runtime integration patch

findings.title: Physical-device validation of lead-leg/floor-boundary reliability is deferred
findings.sourceEvidence: Project boundary explicitly defers physical-device QA.
findings.userConsequence: The pure model is verified, but camera reliability in real homes remains unproven.
findings.recommendedNextTask: Perform device QA after runtime integration exists.
